### Description list
A record's details as label and value pairs, in two columns that stack on compact screens.

Component ID: `description-list`

[Component documentation](https://www.expressivecss.com/description-list.html.md) · [Repository source](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/master/docs/src/pages/description-list.astro) · [Matching tag](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/tree/v0.20.0)

Contract: ExpressiveCSS 0.20.0

Contract SHA-256: `973f4b1a3ceaac5ce31b09d08893eb5c8a72f371da5ab15c1bf3978786a8d4a2`

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `css-only`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Example: An order page shows Status, Ship to and Total for one order as a description list. A table of fifty orders with those columns is a data table.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory.

Support: Label and value columns with a divider per pair, a compact stacked layout, div-wrapped groups and several values per label.

Web adaptation: A native dl, dt and dd; the browser exposes the label-value pairing.

Full parity remains unassessed. Review provenance and specification links: [capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#description-list).

#### Contract

A `dl.description-list` pairs each `<dt>` label with the `<dd>` values after it. Labels take the first column from Medium widths up, with a divider above each pair; at Compact widths, and inside a `.query-container` narrower than 600px, each label sits above its value. A `<div>` may wrap each pair and adds no box. Several `<dd>` elements under one label stack without a divider. Use stat tiles for big numbers instead. CSS only; there is no JavaScript.

#### Syntax

```html
<dl class="description-list">
  <dt>Status</dt><dd>Shipped</dd>
  <dt>Ship to</dt><dd>Alvin Lee, 12 Harbor Road, Portland</dd>
  <dt>Total</dt><dd>$87.00</dd>
</dl>
```

#### Also documented

The Description list section of the [API reference](https://www.expressivecss.com/llm.md) also covers Tokens.

#### Rules

- `description-list-is-a-dl`: Write .description-list as a <dl> with <dt> labels and <dd> values. Divs drawn as two columns read as an unpaired run of text.
